_comment: Copy this file to mcp.json and edit. mcp.json is gitignored. Two server shapes are supported: stdio (spawns a local process) and http (connects to a remote Streamable HTTP / SSE endpoint).

playwright._comment: Playwright browser automation tools. Enable for browser control (navigate, screenshots, form filling, element extraction). Run `npx playwright install chromium` first.

open-connector._comment: OpenConnector gateway (https://github.com/oomol-lab/open-connector). Optional: platform registers this automatically from OPENCONNECTOR_BASE_URL/OPENCONNECTOR_RUNTIME_TOKEN at startup, so you only need this entry if you prefer manual mcp.json wiring. Point url at the runtime's /mcp endpoint and send the runtime token as a Bearer header.
